(fn ShowBeam (Mat Thickness ImpactSize HasTarget Target)
  (bind mz (Variables|Default|GetMuzzle))
  (bind fc (Variables|Default|GetFiringComp))
  (bind pivot (Variables|Default|GetBeamPivot))
  (bind impact (Variables|Default|GetImpactMesh))
  (bind start (Transformation|GetWorldLocation mz))
  (bind dir (Transformation|GetForwardVector fc))
  (bind endpoint (CallFunction|ResolveEnd :Start start :Dir dir :HasTarget HasTarget :Target Target))
  (bind len (Math|Vector|VectorLength (- endpoint start)))
  (bind t (/ Thickness 100.0))
  (bind isz (/ ImpactSize 100.0))
  (Transformation|SetActorLocationAndRotation :NewLocation start :NewRotation (Math|Rotator|FindLookatRotation start endpoint))
  (Transformation|SetRelativeScale3D pivot (Math|Vector|MakeVector t t (/ len 100.0)))
  (Transformation|SetRelativeScale3D impact (Math|Vector|MakeVector isz isz isz))
  (Transformation|SetRelativeLocation impact (Math|Vector|MakeVector len 0.0 0.0))
  (Rendering|Material|SetMaterial (Variables|Default|GetBeamMesh) 0 Mat)
  (Rendering|Material|SetMaterial impact 0 Mat)
  (Rendering|SetActorHiddenInGame :bNewHidden false))

(event EventTick (DeltaSeconds)
  (if (Variables|Default|GetIsReady)
    (bind fc (Variables|Default|GetFiringComp))
    (if (Firing|Control|IsFiring fc)
      (switch Utilities|FlowControl|Switch|SwitchonEFiringModeType (Firing|Control|GetFiringMode fc)
        (:Bullet
          (CallFunction|HideBeam))
        (:TractorBeam
          (CallFunction|ShowBeam :Mat (Variables|Default|GetTractorMaterial) :Thickness (Variables|Default|GetTractorThickness) :ImpactSize (Variables|Default|GetTractorImpactSize) :HasTarget (Firing|TractorBeam|HasTractorTarget fc) :Target (Firing|TractorBeam|GetTractorTarget fc)))
        (:Scanner
          (CallFunction|ShowBeam :Mat (Variables|Default|GetScanMaterial) :Thickness (Variables|Default|GetScanThickness) :ImpactSize (Variables|Default|GetScanImpactSize) :HasTarget (Firing|Scanner|HasScanTarget fc) :Target (Firing|Scanner|GetScanTarget fc)))
        (:Custom
          (CallFunction|HideBeam)))
      (else
        (CallFunction|HideBeam)))))
